name: FORMA Project #3 - Drainage Pipe to Hidden Forest Home

concept.title: Giant Concrete Drainage Pipe -> Hidden Luxury Forest Home
concept.summary: One builder turns an abandoned 3 m precast concrete drainage pipe into a hidden forest home: clear and muck out, pour concrete saddles, waterproof, build the interior, glaze the front, then bury the pipe under an earth berm planted with moss so only the glowing round glass front shows.

budget.note: TEMPORARY cap for the still proof (CP01 text-to-image + s01_mid1 edit, about $0.08). Set back to 0 or to a production cap after the proof.

stills.note: Default workflow: the Studio generates each still (one confirmed fal call), you review, Approve & Continue. CP01 is text-to-image; every later still is an edit of the previous approved still. Model policy (from the CP01-CP02 proof, 2026-10-26): fal-ai/nano-banana/edit ($0.0398) for simple, additive or local edits; fal-ai/nano-banana-2/edit ($0.08) as a per-still override for large-area removals or changes; fal-ai/nano-banana-pro/edit ($0.15) only if Nano Banana 2 fails. Every still is scaled to frame_size so clip start/end frames always match. Upload still is an optional override.

bibles.location: a pine and fern forest clearing at the foot of a wooded slope, soft overcast daylight; open bare-earth clearing left of the pipe, a dirt forest track entering at the left edge
bibles.structure: exactly one standalone precast concrete drainage pipe section, about 3 m inside diameter and 12 m long, on its side along the foot of the slope, never joined to other sections or continuing into the forest - front opening and rear end both visible; the same single pipe, size and position in every shot
bibles.builder: dark beard, olive beanie, rust-orange work jacket, grey canvas work pants, brown boots, work gloves - working, never posing
bibles.materials: everything arrives on the flatbed trailer on the forest track and waits in the material yard at the left until it is used; removed debris and soil go to piles at the left

cameras.wide: the approved CP01 frame: raised about 6 m, front-left three-quarter view near the pipe's long axis, looking down the full pipe length from the front opening (lower right) to the rear end (upper middle); track and open ground left, wooded slope right - the same exact camera position and framing in every wide shot
cameras.interior: inside the pipe at the front end, chest height, looking along its length to the rear end
cameras.front: ground level straight on to the front opening from about 6 m, the full circle in frame
cameras.reveal: farther back down the forest track at about 30 m, low, the mound and glass front in the trees

checkpoints.title: Abandoned pipe discovered
checkpoints.state: Exactly one standalone giant precast concrete drainage pipe section - about 3 m inside diameter, about 12 m long, weathered grey with moss streaks and a chipped rim - lies abandoned on its side along the foot of the wooded slope, its front opening facing the camera and its rear end visible at the far end; no other pipe sections, nothing continuing into the forest. Leaf litter and brush lie around the pipe, a fallen branch lies on the ground in front of the opening among natural loose sticks, and dark silt fills the bottom of the pipe. To the left the open ground and the forest track are untouched.
checkpoints.action: pushes a wheelbarrow in from the forest track at the left edge, loaded with a rake, a bow saw, a shovel and two buckets, looking at the pipe
tools_in_view: wheelbarrow with rake, bow saw, shovel and buckets
not_yet: any sawn branch lengths or stacks
any construction work or building materials

checkpoints.title: Site and pipe mouth cleared
checkpoints.state: The brown leaf litter and the crossed sticks in the lower foreground directly in front of the pipe opening are completely gone. The entire strip of ground between the pipe and the forest track is visibly cleared to bare brown soil. The three sawn branch lengths stay stacked at the left beside the track. One low brush pile at the left beside the track holds only the removed litter and sticks. The wheelbarrow still stands at the pipe's track-side flank where it stood before, with the bow saw visible in it beside the buckets. The pipe interior and the dark silt in its bottom are untouched.
checkpoints.action: rakes the last few leaves off the bare strip toward the brush pile

materials.cleared ground around the pipe: debris raked and wheeled to the brush pile at the left edge

not_yet: any construction materials or later-stage work

checkpoints.title: First load tipped - mucking out under way
checkpoints.state: A small new dark spoil pile of silt sits on the bare ground at the left, next to the brush pile and separate from the three stacked sawn lengths; the emptied wheelbarrow stands tipped up beside it. Inside the pipe the floor is clean grey concrete from the front rim to about a quarter of the way in; dark silt still covers the floor behind that edge all the way to the rear. The shovel leans against the pipe rim; the buckets and bow saw lie on the bare strip by the rake.
checkpoints.action: tips the last of the silt out of the wheelbarrow onto the new spoil pile
not_yet: clean pipe floor beyond the first quarter
flatbed trailer or any building materials

checkpoints.title: Pipe mucked out, materials delivered
checkpoints.state: Time has passed: the pipe interior is mucked out to bare grey concrete all the way to the rear, and the dark spoil pile at the left beside the brush pile is now large. A flatbed trailer stands on the forest track at the left edge, and a material yard is laid out beside it - a lumber stack, a rebar bundle, cement bags on a pallet, a gravel heap, a drum concrete mixer, rolls of black waterproof membrane on a pallet, and a small tracked mini excavator parked beside the pipe.
checkpoints.action: stacks the last cement bags from the trailer onto the pallet

materials.mucked-out pipe interior: silt shoveled into the wheelbarrow and tipped on the spoil pile at the left
materials.material yard with mini excavator: the flatbed trailer on the forest track at the left edge

checkpoints.title: Saddle trenches dug
checkpoints.state: Two shallow footing trenches run along both flanks of the pipe, about 40 cm deep, dug with the mini excavator; the excavated soil has been added to the spoil pile at the left, which is clearly larger.
checkpoints.action: sits in the mini excavator cab, bucket lifting the last scoop of soil out of the far trench

materials.footing trenches along both flanks: soil lifted by the excavator bucket onto the spoil pile at the left

checkpoints.title: Saddle forms and rebar set
checkpoints.state: Timber form boxes stand in both trenches against the pipe's flanks at three points per side, staked and braced, each with a tied rebar cage inside; the lumber stack and rebar bundle in the yard are visibly smaller.
checkpoints.action: kneels in the near trench tying the last rebar cage with wire

materials.saddle formwork with rebar cages: boards from the lumber stack and bars from the rebar bundle in the yard

checkpoints.title: Concrete saddles poured
checkpoints.state: All six form boxes are filled with fresh wet concrete, screeded flat against the pipe; the mixer drum is wet, the cement pallet is half empty and the gravel heap smaller.
checkpoints.action: screeds the top of the last filled form with a board while the mixer turns

materials.concrete saddles: cement bags and gravel mixed in the drum mixer and wheeled to the forms

checkpoints.title: Saddles cured, forms stripped
checkpoints.state: Time has passed: the concrete saddles are hard and pale grey, the timber forms are stripped and stacked back in the yard, and the trenches are backfilled level around the saddles.
checkpoints.action: carries the last stripped form boards back to the yard stack

checkpoints.title: Waterproof membrane on
checkpoints.state: Overlapping strips of black peel-and-stick waterproof membrane cover the top and both sides of the pipe down to the saddles; the two end rims stay bare concrete; the membrane pallet in the yard is nearly empty.
checkpoints.action: presses the last membrane strip down over the top with a roller

materials.waterproof membrane over the pipe: membrane rolls from the pallet in the material yard

checkpoints.title: Inside the pipe (camera change)
checkpoints.state: The same moment from inside: the bare mucked-out concrete tube runs away from the camera to a round opening of daylight and forest at the rear end; daylight also floods in from the front behind the camera.
checkpoints.action: stands inside near the rear opening measuring the diameter with a tape

checkpoints.title: Timber floor platform
checkpoints.state: A level timber floor platform now runs the full length of the pipe on short joists resting across the lower curve, decked with plywood sheets; a few offcuts lie near the front.
checkpoints.action: screws down the last plywood sheet near the rear opening

materials.timber floor platform: joists and plywood from the lumber stack in the yard, carried in through the front

checkpoints.title: Rear end wall framed and closed
checkpoints.state: The rear opening is closed by a timber stud wall sheathed in plywood, with one small round window in its centre showing the forest behind.
built: rear end wall with round window
checkpoints.action: fits the round window frame into the sheathed rear wall

materials.rear end wall with round window: studs and plywood carried in from the yard; the window from its box

checkpoints.title: Insulated cedar lining
checkpoints.state: The curved concrete inner walls and ceiling are fully lined: insulation behind thin cedar slats bent along the curve, running from the floor platform over the top to the other side, all the way to the rear wall.
built: rear end wall with round window
checkpoints.action: nails the last cedar slat into place overhead from a step ladder

materials.insulated cedar lining: insulation bales and cedar slat bundles stacked on the floor platform

checkpoints.title: Interior fitted out
checkpoints.state: Time has passed: a compact kitchenette counter with a sink along the left side, a bed platform with linen at the rear under the round window, warm pendant lights along the ceiling and a wood stove near the front; empty boxes are stacked by the front opening.
built: rear end wall with round window
kitchenette, bed platform, stove and lighting
checkpoints.action: sets a kettle on the stove

materials.kitchenette, bed platform, stove and lig: flat-pack boxes from a second delivery, emptied and stacked by the front opening

checkpoints.title: Front opening (camera change)
checkpoints.state: The same moment from outside: the open circular front end of the membrane-wrapped pipe, seen straight on from ground level at about 6 m; the fitted interior glows inside. A padded crate of curved glass panels and a black steel frame ring lie on the cleared ground in front.
built: rear end wall with round window
kitchenette, bed platform, stove and lighting
glass crate and steel frame on site
checkpoints.action: unbolts the lid of the glass crate

materials.glass crate and steel frame on site: delivered on the trailer and set down in front of the opening

checkpoints.title: Glass front wall installed
checkpoints.state: The whole circular front opening is filled by a black steel frame holding curved glass panels, with a tall glass door on the right side of the circle; the crate is empty.
built: rear end wall with round window
kitchenette, bed platform, stove and lighting
glass crate and steel frame on site
checkpoints.action: seals the last glass panel edge with a caulk gun

materials.glass front wall with door: panels lifted from the padded crate with the suction lifter

checkpoints.title: Wide view, topsoil delivered (camera change)
checkpoints.state: The same site from the wide view: the pipe wrapped in black membrane with its new glass front; a large heap of topsoil delivered next to the spoil pile, pallets of moss mats and potted ferns, and a stack of flat stones in the yard.
built: rear end wall with round window
kitchenette, bed platform, stove and lighting
glass crate and steel frame on site
topsoil, moss, fern and stone delivery
checkpoints.action: climbs into the mini excavator cab

materials.topsoil, moss, fern and stone delivery: the flatbed trailer on the forest track at the left edge

checkpoints.title: Earth berm covers the pipe
checkpoints.state: The spoil pile and topsoil heap are gone: their soil now covers the whole membrane-wrapped pipe in a smooth earth berm blending into the slope behind, so only the glass front and a thin concrete rim remain visible.
built: rear end wall with round window
kitchenette, bed platform, stove and lighting
glass crate and steel frame on site
topsoil, moss, fern and stone delivery
checkpoints.action: smooths the last bucket of soil over the berm top with the excavator

materials.earth berm over the pipe: soil moved by the excavator bucket from the spoil pile and topsoil heap

checkpoints.title: Moss, ferns and stone path
checkpoints.state: The berm is covered in green moss mats with clumps of ferns, a flagstone path leads from the forest track to the glass door, and two low path lights stand beside it; the pallets are empty.
built: rear end wall with round window
kitchenette, bed platform, stove and lighting
glass crate and steel frame on site
topsoil, moss, fern and stone delivery
checkpoints.action: sets the last flagstone by the glass door

materials.moss and fern planting: moss mats and potted ferns from the pallets in the yard
materials.flagstone path with lights: flat stones from the yard stack; lights from their boxes

checkpoints.title: Dusk reveal
checkpoints.state: Dusk: the hidden home is a mossy mound in the forest with a glowing round glass front, warm light spilling onto the flagstone path; the yard is cleared away.
built: rear end wall with round window
kitchenette, bed platform, stove and lighting
glass crate and steel frame on site
topsoil, moss, fern and stone delivery
checkpoints.action: stands at the glass door looking back at the forest

beats.task: cuts the fallen branch in front of the opening with the bow saw and carries the lengths to a stack
beats.after: the long fallen branch that lay in front of the pipe opening is completely gone from the opening; that same branch has been visibly sawn into exactly three short lengths, all three stacked together on the bare ground at the left beside the forest track; there is no brush pile yet; the leaf litter is otherwise largely untouched; the wheelbarrow stays at the pipe's track-side flank; no later clearing and no materials

beats.task: rakes leaf litter along the pipe's track-side flank into the wheelbarrow, to be wheeled to the left edge of the clearing
wheels the wheelbarrow to the front opening, sets the two buckets and the bow saw down on the bare strip, and shovels the first silt from just inside the rim into the barrow
beats.location: track-side flank to the front opening
beats.after: The wheelbarrow stands at the front opening, about half full of dark silt. A strip of the pipe floor about one metre deep just inside the front rim is shoveled to clean grey concrete; all the dark silt behind that strip is untouched. The builder stands in the opening with the shovel. The two buckets and the bow saw lie on the bare strip beside the pipe, near the rake. No spoil pile yet; the brush pile and the three stacked sawn lengths at the left are unchanged

beats.task: keeps shoveling silt from the floor just inside the opening into the barrow until it is heaped
beats.after: The cleaned floor now reaches about a quarter of the way into the pipe: clean grey concrete from the front rim to a clear edge, and dark silt untouched behind that edge all the way to the rear. The wheelbarrow at the front opening is heaped with dark silt; the shovel leans against the pipe rim and the builder grips the barrow handles. The buckets and bow saw still lie on the bare strip by the rake. No spoil pile yet; the brush pile and the three stacked sawn lengths are unchanged

beats.task: wheels the heaped barrow out of the opening to the left and tips it out beside the brush pile, starting the spoil pile
beats.location: front opening to the left beside the brush pile

beats.task: operates the mini excavator: bucket digs the near trench and swings the soil to the spoil pile
beats.after: the trench along the near flank is dug its full length; the far flank is untouched; the spoil pile is larger; the excavator has turned toward the far side

beats.task: bucket lifts the last scoop from the far trench onto the spoil pile
carries boards from the lumber stack and nails the first form box against the pipe
beats.after: two form boxes stand braced in the near trench at the front; no rebar yet; the lumber stack slightly smaller

beats.task: stakes and braces a form box further along
beats.after: all six form boxes stand braced in both trenches; the first two hold tied rebar cages, the rest are empty

beats.task: lowers a rebar cage into the last form and ties it
tips cement and gravel into the turning mixer and fills the wheelbarrow from the drum
beats.after: the two front form boxes are filled with wet concrete, the other four still empty; the mixer drum wet and the cement pallet lower

beats.task: wheels concrete to a form, tips it in and screeds it flat
peels the backing and unrolls the first membrane strip over the top from the front rim
beats.after: black membrane covers the front third of the pipe over the top and both sides; the rest is bare concrete

beats.task: lays an overlapping strip down the near side and rolls it flat
beats.after: membrane covers the front two thirds; the rear third is bare concrete; the membrane pallet is visibly lower

beats.task: rolls the last strip over the top at the rear
carries joists in and sets them across the curve near the front
beats.after: joists and plywood decking cover the front third of the pipe floor; the rest is bare curved concrete

beats.task: lays and screws plywood sheets over the joists
beats.after: the deck covers the front two thirds; joists without decking in the rear third

beats.task: screws down the last sheet at the rear
stands studs in the rear opening and screws them to a top and bottom plate
beats.after: the rear opening is filled with bare timber studs on top and bottom plates, forest visible between them; no plywood yet

beats.task: screws plywood over the studs and cuts the round window hole
presses insulation against the curved wall and nails cedar slats over it
beats.after: the front third of the curved walls and ceiling is lined with cedar slats; bare concrete beyond

beats.task: bends and nails slats over the ceiling curve from the step ladder
beats.after: cedar lining covers the front two thirds; insulation partly fitted in the rear third

beats.task: nails the last slats at the rear wall
bolts the black steel frame ring into the front rim of the pipe
beats.after: the black steel frame ring with its mullions is bolted into the front rim, all openings still empty; the glass panels still in the padded crate

beats.task: lifts a curved glass panel from the crate with the suction lifter and sets it into the frame
excavator bucket carries soil from the spoil pile and spreads it over the rear half of the pipe
beats.after: soil covers the rear half of the pipe and blends into the slope; the front half still shows black membrane; the spoil pile is gone and the topsoil heap untouched

beats.task: bucket carries topsoil onto the front half above the glass
beats.after: soil covers the whole pipe down to the glass front, rough and uneven on top; the topsoil heap is nearly gone

beats.task: bucket smooths the berm top into the slope
carries moss mats from the pallet and lays them over the berm, planting ferns between
beats.after: moss mats and ferns cover the whole berm; the path is still bare soil with the flagstone stack beside it

beats.task: sets flagstones along the path and taps them level with the mallet
slow pull back down the forest track as dusk falls and the interior lights glow; nothing is built
